For decrease tiredness you need to have Couch 04 or 05 in any room.
When value of thirst or tiredness is more than 50, expert go to replicator or couch.
When value of thirst or tiredness is more than 80, gait variant switched to Sad gait F

notes.title: Hello everyone! Welcome to Sci-Fi builder!
notes.content:
Many people asked me when finally it will be accessible for downloading. So, it is here now!

I was working 12 hours per day, every day, during the last six months and finally I am ready to present you Sci-Fi builder game.

I really hope that you will like it, I hope that you will enjoy playing it and will get a lot of fun.

I would be glad to create all new functions which you would ask. I will continue adding new items and details. I will continue working hard to create an excellent product for you. But, to do it, I need your opinion! Only you know how you want to play this game. Only you can tell me what is missing! Please post all your ideas, suggestions and content requests into the discussions sections on Steam or for the faster answer in Telegram group.

The game is in the Early Access, this is because I really want to make it as perfect, as possible and to do it, I need your help too.

The last few weeks I was working on improvements and bugs fixing, but, unfortunately, I am more than sure that here still are some bugs which I haven't noted, so please be so kind and write me all your notes and complaints into the discussions sections on Steam or in Telegram. I would be happy to fix all of them as soon as possible.

So, thank you in advance for all your future help and I would like to thank everyone who helped me in testing during the developing process! And I wish you a good luck in your new life in the new space station!
